## Current status

$$current\ status\ _{pesticides} = 1 - \frac{pesticides\ _{current} - pesticides\ _{ideal}}{pesticides\ _{maximum} - pesticides\ _{ideal}}$$

Where the ideal is zero, and the maximum is the global maximum of kg estimated across all years and regions.

```{r}
current_status_pesticides <- total_ag_pesticides_kg %>% 
  mutate(
    ideal = 0,
    maximum = max(total_pesticide_kg),
    current_status = 1 - ((total_pesticide_kg - ideal)/(maximum - ideal)),
    current_status_final = current_status * 100
  )
```


### plotly

```{r}
library(plotly)

rgn_colors <- c(
  Region_1 = "#C03729",
  Region_2 = "#E68C7C",
  Region_3 = "#FC8F24",
  Region_4 = "#dcaa38",
  Region_5 = "#cbd2a0",
  Region_6 = "#98a25a",
  Region_7 = "#747428",
  Region_8 = "#627391",
  Region_9 = "#8d61a9"
)

## plot the pesticide cs over time
pesticide_plotly <- plotly::plot_ly(
  current_status_pesticides, 
  x = ~year, 
  y = ~current_status_final, 
  color = ~rgn_id, 
  colors = rgn_colors,
  type = "scatter", 
  mode = "lines+markers"
) %>% 
  layout(
    title = "Clean Waters: Pesticide Current Status",
    xaxis = list(title = "ano // Year"),
    yaxis = list(title = "Puntaje // Percent (out of 100)")
  ) %>%
  add_lines( 
    x = range(current_status_pesticides$year), 
    y = c(100, 100),
    line = list(color = "black", width = 2, dash = "dash"),
    name = "Meta // Goal (100/100)",
    inherit = FALSE
  )
pesticide_plotly
```
